title: Marina Bay evening (feasible, two shows)
text: I'm free from 14:00 to 22:30 with S$120. I want the Flower Dome and Cloud Forest, Garden Rhapsody, Spectra and dinner at Lau Pa Sat. If there's time, the Singapore Flyer too.

title: USS + Night Safari on S$100 (budget conflict)
text: I have from 9am until 11:55pm and S$100. Universal Studios and the Night Safari are both must-dos.

title: Too much for 4 hours and S$30 (two independent conflicts)
text: 4 hours from 10am and S$30. I need the National Museum, lunch at Maxwell and the ArtScience Museum.

title: A long dinner leaves no slot for Garden Rhapsody
text: Evening from 18:00 to 22:00. I want to see Garden Rhapsody, and have a 90-minute dinner at Lau Pa Sat between 19:30 and 21:00.

title: Night Safari before the Zoo (opening hours make it impossible)
text: Whole day from 8am. I want to do the Night Safari first and then the Singapore Zoo.

title: Museum morning from Orchard, back by 5pm (start location, order, lunch window)
text: Starting from Orchard Road at 9:30. National Museum first, then lunch at Maxwell after 12:30, then the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple. I need to be back at Orchard by 5pm.

title: Sentosa day (theme park, show, optional luge)
text: 10am to 9pm on Sentosa with S$150: Universal Studios, then Wings of Time in the evening. The Skyline Luge if there's time.

title: A place we do not know (needs clarification)
text: I'd like to see the Merlion and the Taj Mahal this afternoon.
